description: PreToolUse Write|Edit -> format_pre: prettier languages (jsts/json/yaml/markdown/css/scss/less/html/vue/graphql/shell/java/php) formatted in-process before the write with the prettier — and the bundled java/php/shell plugins — inside this plugin's MCP server. PostToolUse Write|Edit -> format_post: kotlin/python/go formatted on disk after the write via each tool's CLI. CwdChanged -> cwd_changed: refresh that server's cached prettier ignore state for the new working directory and drop the old one's. PostToolUse EnterWorktree -> worktree_entered: same, via the signal that actually fires when a background-job session's cwd moves into a worktree (CwdChanged does not).
